events.title: Minor Update (v0.8.7) – Balance Changes & Improvements
events.summary: Hello everyone!We've released a minor update (v0.8.7) for the demo.Balance ChangesSlightly nerfed Sandworm's skill.Slightly buffed Mist Monster's skill.Adjusted Leia's merge recipe.Bug Fixes & General ImprovementsFixed an issue where curse damage was not included in DPS calculations.Added visual effects for AoE attacks and buff abilities.Updated some textures.Fixed issues with some background assets.Thank you for playing! We'll continue improving the demo based on your feedback.

events.title: The Demo for Lineup, Dark Lord! Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hi everyone, developer here!The demo for Lineup, Dark Lord! is finally available!We've been hard at work since opening the Steam store page, and now we can finally say, “Give it a try!”The demo includes a short campaign mode and an Arena Mode, where you can try out a few different combinations and put your strategies to the test.The game is still in development, so we'd love to hear what you think. Feel free to share combinations you enjoyed, things that felt inconvenient, or anything you'd like
